caption: The drawing depicts a wooden towel rack standing upright against a plain, light beige background. The towel rack consists of two vertical brown wooden supports connected by three horizontal bars, all of which are also brown and appear to be made from the same material. The vertical supports are each attached to flat, elongated wooden feet at the bottom, which provide stability to the structure. The towel rack is rendered with visible shading and lines to indicate the contours and angles of the wood, and it casts a light shadow on the surface beneath it. The words "Towel Rack" are written in gray, minimally stylized text below the image. There is also a signature or handwritten note in the lower right corner.
title: Shaker Towel Rack
